responsibility: Implements the transmutability decision procedure by driving a `MaybeTransmutableQuery` through successive layout representations and producing an `Answer`. It converts rustc types into layout trees when available, prunes source and destination layouts according to inhabitance and assumed safety rules, lowers trees to NFAs and DFAs, recursively compares automaton states with memoization, and combines per-path results into unconditional or conditional transmutability outcomes with specific failure reasons.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `layout/mod.rs`, this `mod.rs` is the analysis engine built on top of the layout vocabulary. It owns `MaybeTransmutableQuery`, the staged `Tree`→`Nfa`→`Dfa` answering pipeline, pruning according to `Assume`, and the logic that combines results into `Answer` and `Reason` values rather than defining the underlying layout types.
